camera.fovRationale: 2*atan(half vertical extent / abs(z)) from camera.view_frame(scene) using original square frame and pixel aspect, not camera.angle_y based on sensor height.

lights.name: FittedArea_1
lights.unitRationale: Exact normalized Blender AREA energy in watts; inspected node multiplier is neutral white*1, so no energy/color adjustment is applied. No watts-to-lumens conversion or visual calibration. Using this number as renderer areaLight.power is only a baseline, not verified photometric equivalence. size is diameter for DISK; sizeY is the raw data field; effectiveSizeY records the shape interpretation.

gltfSpecularMap.formula: alpha = 2 * linear source level; source IOR retained; no clamping

baseColorBake.sourceSignal: Original active Base Color network, including source reflectance gain
baseColorBake.scaleRationale: Stored sRGB encodes linear Base Color / multiplier; viewer must multiply decoded linear color by baseColorMultiplier. This preserves values above one without clipping or arbitrary tuning.

baseColorBake.sourceSignal: Original active Base Color network, including source reflectance gain
baseColorBake.scaleRationale: Stored sRGB encodes linear Base Color / multiplier; viewer must multiply decoded linear color by baseColorMultiplier. This preserves values above one without clipping or arbitrary tuning.

notes: Source vertices, local normals, mesh matrixWorld and camera matrixWorld are retained without any axis conversion or normalization.

Matrices are column-major. Do not overwrite the source camera orientation with a lookAt(controlsTarget) operation on initial display; controlsTarget is the head bounding-box center, not necessarily the exact source optical-axis target.

Blender Weight sockets here are disabled and unavailable internal sockets. Their stored zero was left untouched; unchanged source replay renders correctly. They are not active zero shading multipliers.
SSS weight is zero in these source files. Preserve its method/radius/scale as recorded; do not enable SSS.
glTF clearcoat cannot express the independent source eye coat IOR; apply materials[].clearcoatIor using a compatible shader or disclose its absence.
World color*strength describes environment radiance, not a calibrated ambient-light intensity. Film transparency affects background visibility, not environment illumination.
AREA disk shape, spread, shadows, GI and Cycles Principled BRDF/color-management behavior are not guaranteed to match a raster viewer. No light or material tuning has been performed.

EyeRightMaterial has source reflectance above linear one. Apply baseColorMultiplier in the viewer; standalone glTF cannot store baseColorFactor above one. The multiplier is derived algebraically from source pixels, not tuned.
uvConvention: Only texture coordinates convert v_gltf=1-v_Blender for PNG top-left origin. Positions, normals and matrices have no axis conversion.
